commands.command: targeted compatible project creation store/HTTP tests with -race

verifiedBehavior: A project and its first enabled key are created atomically in the addressed organization team.
The creator is added to the target team idempotently.
Custom and derived slugs, platform defaults, duplicate conflicts and strict invalid inputs are covered.
Session owner/admin, org:write Bearer, CSRF and foreign-organization boundaries are enforced.
The new project is immediately readable through project, team and key routes.
